title: Abilities
summary: Design and technical contract for the data-driven abilities subsystem: AbilityDef, Aim, Cost, Requirement, the Effect trait, targeting cursor, AI tactic, save and phased build.
notes: Located in docs/design/ (no path or filename convention). Strongest signals are SPEC: Rust type definitions (AbilityDef, Aim, Cost, Requirement, Effect trait), a full RON schema with option space, effect contract tables, crate placement and required tests. Also carries DOC-style design rationale and several embedded decisions (effects as types, fuel as a stat, minds must use abilities), but no ADR Status/Decision/Consequences structure; 'Status: phases A to F built' is a build-progress marker, not an ADR status. Resolved SPEC over DOC per ambiguity rule. The document reflects built code and records deviations from the original plan inline, so the revised statements (e.g. Inflict not Afflict, seven engine effects, cooldown counted from use) supersede the older table and RON example text within it. Output filename uses a path-derived suffix instead of the SHA-256 prefix because no hashing tool was available to this classifier.
